[TASK: 2560x1440 2K QHD 16:9 ARCHITECTURAL RELIGHTING & STATIC RECONSTRUCTION]
Transform the reference photogrammetry plate into a razor-sharp, photorealistic 6x7 medium-format architectural survey photograph.

MANDATORY TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. PLANAR RECTIFICATION & GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat the reference image as an immutable spatial coordinate frame. Eliminate all 3D mesh polygon wobble, melted facades, and distorted rooflines. Plumb all vertical walls to true gravity vertical. Render razor-sharp ashlar courses, straight timber sash mullions, and crisp slate roofs.
2. STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the carriageway with authentic road surfacing, stone setts, whinstone kerbs, and clean flagstone pavements.
3. BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY: Overwrite all raw 3D mesh blob foliage with authentic seasonal canopy structures matching the target date. Zero green summer foliage during dormant/autumn/winter periods:
   - **Botanical Taxa (Drummond Place Gardens)**: Dominant mature urban broadleaf canopy composed of *Ulmus glabra* (wych elm), *Acer pseudoplatanus* (sycamore), *Tilia × europaea* (common lime), *Fagus sylvatica* (European beech), and *Platanus × acerifolia* (London plane).
- **Date-Grounded Phenology (November 11)**: Mid-November late-autumn senescence; 75–90% canopy defoliation exposing complex architectural ramification and dark wet bark; residual desiccated ochre, russet, and dull yellow-brown leaves concentrated within lower crown branch bifurcations; damp fallen leaf litter layering underlying lawn turf.
4. OPTICAL DEPTH: Pin-sharp infinite depth of field (f/11). Zero lens blur, tilt-shift, or depth-of-field falloff across foreground and background.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING (OVERCAST): 100% overcast cloud cover. Soft omnidirectional 6500K diffuse skylight. Zero harsh directional cast shadows; render ambient contact occlusion under cornices and ledges only.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
Medium format 6x7 architectural survey of London Street looking west toward the terminal crescent of Drummond Place, Edinburgh. Symmetrical Georgian Neoclassical terraces constructed from blonde Craigleith sandstone ashlar with channelled ground-floor rustication, continuous moulded cornices, and raised blocking courses. Strict vertical alignment across three-storey facades over sunken basement areas fronted by cast-iron spearhead railings. Regular fenestration of 12-pane timber double-hung sash windows with white-painted frames. Pitched Scottish slate roofs with recessed slate-hung piended dormers and tall ashlar chimneystacks with circular terracotta cans. Foreground roadway surfaced in dark grey whinstone setts flanked by tooled sandstone kerbs and Caithness flagstone pavements. Center background occupied by Drummond Place Gardens with mature Acer pseudoplatanus, Ulmus glabra, and Tilia × europaea exhibiting advanced November defoliation, dense dark grey skeletal branch structures, and sparse clinging russet-brown foliage over damp turf. Historical coal-smoke soot patination under string courses and subtle rain-wash weathering streaks across stone facades. Distant city skyline reveals continuous Georgian stone roofscape and Gothic spires. Zero pedestrians, zero vehicles, zero temporary clutter. High-resolution orthorectified static documentation.
